Bill.BriefDescription: Providing for groundwater monitoring and assessments.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to groundwater monitoring and assessment; amendingRCW 43.27A.130; adding a new section to chapter 90.54 RCW; andrecodifying RCW 43.27A.130.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 43.27A.130 and 1988 c 127 s 26 are each amended toread as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The department of ecology may make complete inventories of thestate's water resources and enter into such agreements with thedirector of the United States geological survey as will ((insure))ensure that investigations and surveys are carried on in an economicalmanner. (2) The department shall complete a data gap analysis by June 30,2009, to evaluate groundwater monitoring activities across the state,on a basinbybasin basis. This study will inform future decisions todevelop an effective groundwater monitoring program. This study mustinclude: (a) Summarizing historic and current monitoring of ambientgroundwater levels and water quality within each WRIA as defined in RCW90.82.020; p. 1 SSB 6593 (b) Evaluating the completeness and quality of the data andconclusions produced from such monitoring; (c) Identifying priorities for enhanced groundwater monitoringwhere water levels and water quality are of concern; (d) Evaluating and recommending quality controls and otherprotocols associated with data collection and management; (e) Summarizing and compiling existing studies of groundwaterlevels, water quality, and monitoring activities; and (f) Recommending the components necessary to establish acomprehensive, statewide ambient groundwater monitoring and assessmentprogram and the funding necessary to implement the program.
RCW 43.27A.130 is recodified as a section inchapter 90.54 RCW.
